# Task P2-16: Frontend — Queue page and the Interactive search modal

**Phase:** 2 · **Depends on:** P2-14 (queue/release API, generated types), P2-13b (SignalR `queue` messages) · **Suggested tier:** cheap worker · **Estimated size:** M

## Goal
The user can watch downloads happen and step in: an *arr-style **Queue** page with live progress (SignalR), states, the peer's queue position and the reason a download failed, with "remove", "remove and blocklist" and "blocklist and search again"; and an **Interactive search** modal, opened from a song, that lists every Soulseek candidate with its score, the score breakdown and the rejection reasons, and grabs the one the user picks. Search buttons on the Wanted and Library pages trigger an automatic search (`SongSearch` command) or open the modal.

## Deliverables
1. `frontend/src/api/queue.ts` — hooks on the generated client (`frontend/src/api/schema.d.ts`, regenerated by P2-14; types from `components['schemas']`): `useQueue(paging, includeFinished)` (`GET /api/v1/queue`), `useQueueStatus()` (`GET /api/v1/queue/status`), `useRemoveQueueItem()` (`DELETE /api/v1/queue/{id}` with `blocklist`/`skipRedownload`), `useInteractiveSearch(songId, enabled)` (`GET /api/v1/release?songId=`; `staleTime: 0`, no retry, `gcTime` short — every open runs a fresh search), `useGrabRelease()` (`POST /api/v1/release`), `useSongSearchCommand()` (`POST /api/v1/command` with `{ name: 'SongSearch', body: JSON.stringify({ songId }) }` — follow how the paste flow posts `BulkAddSongs` in `src/api/songs.ts`). Query keys `['queue']`, `['queue','status']`.
2. `frontend/src/app/signalr.ts` — a `queue` message invalidates `['queue']` (both list and status); a `song` message invalidates `['songs']`, `['wanted']` and `['history']` (the keys the existing pages use — check them). Keep the existing handlers.
3. `frontend/src/pages/QueuePage.tsx` (+ route `activity/queue` as the **first** tab of the Activity page — `ActivityPage.tsx` has History / Blocklist tabs; add Queue before them and make it the default tab) — table columns: song (title + artist), state (badge: Queued / Queued by peer (#place) / Downloading / Completed / Importing / Imported / Failed / Cancelled), progress bar with percent and size, source/peer, file name (`displayName`, full `remotePath` in a tooltip), quality, attempt, message (failure reason, wrapped), age; row actions menu: **Remove**, **Remove and blocklist**, **Blocklist and search again** (confirm dialog for the last two, `@mantine/modals` is **not** installed — use a Mantine `Modal` you control). A "Show finished" toggle (`includeFinished`). Loading, empty ("Nothing is downloading") and error states (`src/components/DataState.tsx`). Paging with the existing `PagedTable` component.
4. `frontend/src/components/InteractiveSearchModal.tsx` — props `{ songId, songTitle, artistCredit, opened, onClose }`: runs `useInteractiveSearch` when opened (spinner with "Searching Soulseek… this can take up to a minute when the search budget is busy"), then a table sorted as returned: accepted first. Columns: score (number with a colored badge: ≥ 850 green, accepted yellow, rejected gray), file name (+ folder path in a tooltip), peer (free slot icon, queue length, speed in KB/s or MB/s), quality name, size (MB), length (m:ss, highlighted when it differs from the song by > 3 s), rejection reasons as red badges with the message in a tooltip. Clicking a row expands the **score breakdown** (title / artist / duration / identity / quality / availability / source / each adjustment with its points / total, and "capped: unknown duration"). A **Grab** button per row (also on rejected rows, with a confirm "This candidate was rejected: <reasons>. Grab anyway?") → `useGrabRelease` → notification "Grabbed <file>" and close; 409 → notification "Already downloading". Outcome/message line from the response at the top ("12 candidates, none acceptable: …").
5. Search buttons: on `WantedPage.tsx` (Missing and Cutoff Unmet rows) and `LibraryPage.tsx` song rows — an icon button **Search** (automatic: `SongSearch` command, notification "Searching for <title>") and an icon button **Interactive search** (opens the modal). Use `lucide-react` icons already in the project (`Search`, `UserSearch` or similar — check what `AppLayout.tsx` imports).
6. Tests (Vitest + Testing Library, the existing fetch mock and `ResizeObserver` stub in the test setup — see `src/pages/ActivityPage.test.tsx`): `QueuePage.test.tsx` — renders items with states/progress/place, the remove menu calls `DELETE` with the right query for each action, empty state, "Show finished" adds `includeFinished=true`; `InteractiveSearchModal.test.tsx` — renders releases in order with score badges and rejection badges, expanding a row shows the breakdown, Grab posts `candidateId`, a rejected row asks for confirmation first, 409 shows the notification; `signalr` — a `queue` message invalidates the queue queries (follow the existing signalr test if there is one, else test the handler function); Wanted/Library search buttons post the command / open the modal.
